title: Deployments
content_markdown:
# Deployments

Standard deploy: `az pipelines run --name web-prod`.
Rollback: redeploy previous artifact, then clear cache in Front Door.

title: Overview
content_markdown:
# Architecture

Services: api-gateway, billing, notifications.
Data: Postgres (primary), Redis (cache).
Auth: Entra ID workloads + managed identity.

title: Local-Dev
content_markdown:
# Local dev

1. `make bootstrap`
2. `docker compose up -d`
3. `./scripts/seed-dev.sh`

Use `AZURE_TENANT_ID` + `AZURE_CLIENT_ID`.

title: Definition-of-Done
content_markdown:
# Definition of Done

- Tests pass in CI
- Code reviewed (2 approvals)
- Feature flag documented
- Observability: logs + dashboard link

title: Secrets-Rotation
content_markdown:
# Secrets rotation

Key Vault: rotate app secrets quarterly.
Pipelines use variable groups backed by Key Vault.
Emergency rotation: follow incident template.

title: Threat-Model
content_markdown:
# Threat model

Assets: customer PII, billing events.
Entry points: public API, webhooks.
Controls: WAF, rate limits, signed payloads.

# Release notes (2026-06)

- Added invoice PDF export
- Reduced p95 latency 18%
- Migrated webhook retries to queue-based worker

title: Schema
content_markdown:
# Data schema

Core tables: accounts, subscriptions, invoices, events.
Migrations via Flyway.
ERD: see `/Data/erd.png` in repo.

title: Getting-Started
content_markdown:
# Getting started

Request access to the org, then clone `ssh://dev.azure.com/contoso/Payments/_git/payments-api`.
Create a feature branch from `main`.

title: Rate-Limits
content_markdown:
# Rate limits

API gateway: 300 rpm per client-id.
Burst: 60 requests/10s.
If you see 429s, check Front Door rules and token reuse.

title: 0007-Queue-Retries

Decision: move webhook retries to Azure Storage Queue.
Reason: avoid thundering herd during outages.
Status: Accepted.
